name: Elsa
source:
Queen of the Elf Kingdom. Elf supremacist. 

She is noble and proud. She is dignified and gives the impression that she is more fearful than kind. However, the support of her people is strong, and she is the existence of her country. 

She cares about the prosperity of the elves above all else, and although she is generally kind to elves, she sometimes makes cold decisions.
